'''Fixer''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|Clone cold assault trooper]] who served in the [[Devil Dogs]] of the [[44th Special Operations Division]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Fixer and his fellow brother [[Jark (clone trooper)|Jark]] were assigned to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], who were planning to destroy the local [[Weather-control station]], and helped them bury several native [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] killed by CIS [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Later, the group was ambushed by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], and Fixer was one of the few clones who survived the ambush. After the group finally reached the Weather-control station, Fixer sliced into the junction box and changed the coordinates for the upcoming artificial storm, directing it at the station itself. The station was destroyed and mission's objective was achieved.
